slides.texte_overlay:
Things that make a man
easy to be around
He doesn't complain much. Everyone has problems, but he doesn't make every conversation about them. People leave his company lighter.
He's easy to plan with. Flexible, on time and quick to reply. Making plans with him never feels like work. He respects people's time, which everyone notices.
He laughs easily. At jokes, at himself, at little absurd moments. Shared laughter makes any time together better. He never makes people feel stupid, even when they're wrong.
He doesn't need to win every discussion. He shares his view, listens to yours and lets it go. Conversations stay fun. Being around him feels good.
Before: I had little to add in group conversations. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I always have something fun to share.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I had little to add in group conversations. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I always have something fun to share.

slides.texte_overlay: He notices what others need. A refill, a ride home, a quiet word to someone left out. Small attentions make people feel at ease.
He's the same every time. No sudden moods, no drama. People feel relaxed around someone they can predict. Calm, steady men are the ones people always want close by.
